description: A Svelte applied-filters bar over a support queue, built from the SvGrid UI kit. An Add filter SvMenu lists fields with their values as submenus, and picking one adds a removable SvChip such as Status: Open. The ticket list, a result count and Clear all update with every chip, and a read-only SvTextInput shows the URL query string the filters would produce, with a Copy link action.
keywords: svelte filters to url query string

faq.question: How are several filters combined?
faq.answer: Chips of the same field are OR-ed and different fields are AND-ed. With Status: Open and Status: Pending you see tickets in either status; adding Priority: Urgent keeps only urgent ones among them. A value that is already applied is disabled in the menu so it cannot be added twice.

faq.question: Where does the query string come from?
faq.answer: A $derived builds a URLSearchParams and appends one field=value pair per chip, lowercased, so two status chips give ?status=open&status=pending. In a SvelteKit page you pass the same params to goto, and on load read them back with page.url.searchParams.getAll('status').

faq.question: How do I add another field to the menu?
faq.answer: Pass your own list as createFilterChips({ fields }) (the sample list is the default), each entry with a key that exists on the row type, a label and its values. The menu items, the chip label and the filtering all read from that list, so nothing else needs to change.
